trial.prompt:
本版本在批量审批基础上新增同事务审批日志与幂等结果。只有当前已认证 approver 可以审批当前租户内他人创建的 submitted 目标，任何目标无效则全批拒绝且 Purchase/ApprovalAudit/ActionRequest 全部不变。1..100 个不重复非空字符串 ID，每项 UTF-8 长度不超过100字节，严格仅含 ids 的 JSON 对象，未知/重复字段、错误类型和无效 JSON 返回400。匿名401，requester403。认证和角色先于报文检查。最大请求体65536字节，超限413；恰好65536字节的合法输入允许。Idempotency-Key 必需且只能有一个值，长度1..128，字符集A-Z/a-z/0-9/点/下划线/冒号/连字符。成功200，响应仅 approvedIds，按UTF-8字典序排序。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同作用域同 key、同目标集合的重放返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同key不同目标409。作用域为 operation+tenant+actor+key。不同key不得再次审批已审批记录。每个成功目标恰好一条完整 ApprovalAudit；每个成功作用域恰好一条完成态 ActionRequest。ActionRequest.requestHash 为小写十六进制 SHA-256，输入为 "bulk-approve.v3" 加换行符，再依 UTF-8 字节序排序后的每个 ID 依次拼接 "<UTF-8字节长度>:<ID>"（无分隔符）；ActionRequest.response 为 {"approvedIds":[排序后ID]}。已确认回滚的失败不占用key；移除受控写入故障后同key可重试。网络或提交确认丢失时不保证未提交，客户端应使用同key重试以读取已提交结果。并发同key同集合两次均200，只提交一次；并发同key不同集合一个200、另一个409；不同key的重叠批次只能一个成功，败者独有目标不变。客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。保留原有API行为；新日志/幂等契约仅适用于本Action，旧单条审批API未迁移。
Evolve the existing atomic batch approval to add audit and scoped idempotency.
Both conditions use guarded RLS. The shared HTTP adapter already validates input and binds demo identity.
Only edit/add internal/candidate/ Go code. All other exports, dependencies, Git settings and tests are protected.
Preserve the original APIs. New returns: protocol.Result, replayed bool, error; protocol.Rejection controls HTTP rejection status.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
Use go test ./... and python3 visible_smoke.py only if an independent public test service is supplied.
Private database credentials are unavailable during generation. Public SQL schema is in SCHEMA.sql.
Capability: protected internal/action exposes New(ctx,pool,"") and Executor.BulkApprove(ctx,identity,key,ids). Its Result and Rejection types are distinct from protocol types; adapt values/errors at your boundary.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.

8. ✅ Idempotency-Key required, exactly one, 1-128 chars, A-Z/a-z/0-9/._:-

10. ✅ First success: Idempotency-Replayed=false
11. ✅ Same scope+key+targets: replay=true, same response, no new writes
12. ✅ Same key, different targets: 409
13. ✅ Scope: operation+tenant+actor+key
14. ✅ Different keys on same targets: only one succeeds
15. ✅ Each success creates ApprovalAudit record
16. ✅ Each success creates ActionRequest record
17. ✅ ActionRequest.requestHash: SHA-256 lowercase hex of "bulk-approve.v3\n" + sorted IDs with "<len>:<id>" format
18. ✅ ActionRequest.response: {"approvedIds":[sorted IDs]}
